map.计算 V 带/平皮带传动比、带速、包角、基准长度及大带轮转速。: Compute the ratio, belt speed, wrap angle, reference length and large pulley speed of a V-belt or flat belt drive.
map.带传动：小带轮线速度 v = π·d₁·n₁ ÷ 60000 (m/s)；传动比: Belt drive: small pulley linear speed v = π·d₁·n₁ ÷ 60000 (m/s); ratio i = d₂ ÷ [d₁·(1 − ε)], where d is the pulley diameter, n the speed and ε the slip rate.
map.传动比 i = d₂ / d₁（考虑滑动率时 i_实际 = d₂ / [d₁(1: Ratio i = d₂ / d₁ (accounting for the slip rate, i_actual = d₂ / [d₁(1−ε)])
map.带速 v = π·d₁·n₁ / 60000（m/s），推荐 V 带 5~25: Belt speed v = π·d₁·n₁ / 60000 (m/s), with 5~25 m/s recommended for V-belts
map.按带轮直径、中心距、转速与滑动率计算理论/实际传动比、带速、包角与基准带长，完成: Compute the theoretical and actual ratio, belt speed, wrap angle and reference belt length from pulley diameters, centre distance, speed and slip rate to complete the belt drive geometry design.
map.由传递功率与带速反算有效拉力，为选带型（根数）与初张紧力提供依据。: Back-calculate the effective tension from the transmitted power and belt speed to support belt type (number of strands) and initial tension selection.
map.校核小轮包角与带速是否落在推荐区间，判断方案是否需要调整。: Check whether the small pulley wrap angle and belt speed fall in the recommended range and judge whether the scheme needs adjustment.
map.理论传动比 i = d2/d1；实际传动比 i′ = d2/[d1·(1−ε)]: Theoretical ratio i = d2/d1; actual ratio i′ = d2/[d1·(1−ε)] where ε is the slip rate; belt speed v = π·d1·n1/60000 (m/s); driven pulley speed n2 = n1/i′; small pulley wrap angle α1 ≈ 180° − 57.3·(d2−d1)/a; reference belt length Ld = 2a + π(d1+d2)/2 + (d2−d1)²/(4a); effective tension F = P×1000/v (N, with P in kW). Recommended belt speed 5~25 m/s; the wrap angle correction factor has an empirical value ≈ 0.9 + max[0,(α1−120)/60×0.1].
map.d1=125 mm、d2=315 mm、a=800 mm、n1=1450 r/m: d1=125 mm, d2=315 mm, a=800 mm, n1=1450 r/min, slip rate 1.5%, power 5.5 kW: i = 2.52, i′ = 315/(125×0.985) ≈ 2.56; v ≈ 9.49 m/s; n2 ≈ 566.8 r/min; α1 ≈ 166.4°; Ld ≈ 2302.4 mm; effective tension F = 5500/9.49 ≈ 579.5 N; wrap angle correction factor about 0.98. The belt speed falls in the recommended 5~25 m/s range, so the scheme is workable.
map.理论传动比和实际传动比为什么不同？: Why do the theoretical and actual ratios differ?
map.理论值只由带轮直径决定；实际值计入弹性滑动造成的转速损失（1~2%），是输出转速: The theoretical value depends only on the pulley diameters; the actual value accounts for the speed loss from elastic slip (1~2%) and is the true basis for estimating output speed and the downstream speed chain.
map.有效拉力有什么用？: What is the effective tension used for?
map.有效拉力 F = P/v 是带传递圆周力的大小，用于确定带根数（z ≥ F/[F: Effective tension F = P/v is the circumferential force the belt transmits, used to determine the number of strands (z ≥ F/[F]), the initial tension and the shaft load. It is the starting point of belt drive strength design and also determines the shaft and bearing loads.
